test_repr_dtype: test the repr output of pandas integer dtypes like Int8Dtype, Int16Dtype, Int64Dtype, UInt64Dtype
test_repr_array: test the repr output of a small pandas IntegerArray with integer values and NA entries
test_repr_array_long: test the repr output of a long pandas IntegerArray with truncation and ellipsis
test_frame_repr: test the repr output of a pandas DataFrame containing an IntegerArray column
test_dtypes: test pandas integer dtype construction and verify signed vs unsigned kind classification
